body: Read CR-r7-r4-combined, project rules, and target files
differs: Follow-up from CR-r7-r4-combined (continue). Unlike A1 (which fixed install_cmd overwriting ~/.local/bin/<cmd> from linked worktrees), A2 updates _launch_line() in scripts/kit.py and kit/orchestrator.template.md so agy orchestrator guides and step new output point at kit.py launch <post>, with tests in tests/test_launch_runtime.py.

cases.text: _launch_line() under agy (via env or explicit cli="agy") returns python3 -I .kit/kit.py launch <post> (preserving non-inherit model flags) and never tells the orchestrator to run step prompt or raw invoke_subagent directly
step_new(), _launch_workflow(), and resume() under agy emit python3 -I .kit/kit.py launch <post> (including --continue / --take guidance) rather than raw invoke_subagent instructions

every agy orchestrator guide (both kit/orchestrator.template.md and the short kit/ORCHESTRATOR.template.md, plus their installed .kit/ copies) directs part launches through kit.py launch <post> instead of hand-writing prompts or calling raw invoke_subagent directly

intent.goal: "In agy, orchestrators launch parts through kit.py launch <post> uniformly (matching CLI and web) instead of step prompt + raw invoke_subagent, so every launch writes runner=agy, checks the device cap, prepares the branch, and emits the invoke_subagent call."
intent.real: live Board repo agy guides and Harmonize scratch dry run under ANTIGRAVITY_AGENT=1 (install.py --update --no-cmd, kit.py resume, _launch_line, and both .kit/ orchestrator guides verified)

real_project.command: python3 -I /home/anon/board-a2/install.py /tmp/a2-harmonize-dryrun --update --no-cmd && ANTIGRAVITY_AGENT=1 python3 -I .kit/kit.py resume && _launch_line + grep orchestrator guides
real_project.output: install.py updated .kit/kit.py, .kit/orchestrator.md, .kit/ORCHESTRATOR.md (exit 0); resume printed kit.py launch relaunch lines (exit 0); _launch_line returned python3 -I .kit/kit.py launch h1-sample; both .kit/orchestrator.md and .kit/ORCHESTRATOR.md contain kit.py launch <post id>
